```{r warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
library(readxl)
library(glarma)
library(tidyverse)
```


```{r}
base_1 <- read_excel("./donnee.xlsx")
base_1$Mois <- as.factor(base_1$Mois)
```

#Deces



```{r message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}

base <- base_1%>%dplyr::select(-c(accidentologie,legers, graves,Deces))

y <- base_1$Deces

variables <- names(base)



make_X <- function(vars, data) {
  if (length(vars) == 0) {
    return(matrix(1, nrow = nrow(data), ncol = 1))
  } else {
    return(model.matrix(as.formula(paste("~", paste(vars, collapse = "+"))), data = data))
  }
}

# Modèle initial avec toutes les variables
current_vars <- variables
X <- make_X(current_vars, base)

mod <- glarma(y = y, X = X, type = "NegBin", thetaLags  = c(13))
best_aic <- mod$aic
cat("AIC initial :", best_aic, "\n")

# Boucle backward stepwise
improve <- TRUE

while (improve && length(current_vars) > 0) {
  aics <- c()
  models <- list()
  
  for (var in current_vars) {
    temp_vars <- setdiff(current_vars, var)
    X_temp <- make_X(temp_vars, base)
    
    fit <- tryCatch({
      glarma(y = y, X = X_temp, type = "NegBin", thetaLags  = c(13) )
    }, error = function(e) NULL)
    
    if (!is.null(fit)) {
      aics <- c(aics, fit$aic)
      models[[var]] <- fit
    } else {
      aics <- c(aics, Inf)
    }
  }
  
  min_aic <- min(aics)
  best_idx <- which.min(aics)
  
  if (min_aic < best_aic) {
    best_aic <- min_aic
    var_to_remove <- current_vars[best_idx]
    current_vars <- setdiff(current_vars, var_to_remove)
    cat("Removed:", var_to_remove, "| New AIC:", best_aic, "\n")
  } else {
    improve <- FALSE
  }
}

cat("\n✅ Variables finales :", paste(current_vars, collapse = ", "), "\n")


```


```{r}
# Modèle final

h <- c("VU","Goud_bon","Lat_bon","Vh_bon_etat", "PL_VL", "PL_R2", "PL_Pieton",  "VL_R2", "VL_Pieton", "R2_R2","Nb_vehicules")

h_1 <- c("VU","Goud_bon","Lat_bon","Vh_bon_etat", "PL_VL", "PL_R2", "PL_Pieton",  "VL_R2", "VL_Pieton", "R2_R2")
# h <- c("RN","Vh_21_30","Goud_bon","Jour","Lat_bon","CT_non","Assure_non", "PL_seul", "PL_R2", "PL_Pieton",  "VL_R2", "VL_Pieton")

X = make_X(h_1,base)
X_final <- make_X(h_1, base)
```


```{r}
mod_deces_1 <- glarma(y = y, X = X_final, type = "NegBin",offset = log(base$Nb_accidents), thetaLags  = c(13))
summary(mod_deces_1)
```



```{r}
mod_final_deces <- glarma(y = y, X = X_final, type = "NegBin",offset = log(base$Nb_accidents), thetaLags  = c(13))
summary(mod_final_deces)
```
### Diagnostics modele DECES



```{r}
likeTests(mod_final_deces)
plot.glarma(mod_final_deces)
```


```{r}
model_glm <- MASS::glm.nb(y~X_final)
x <- step(model_glm, direction = "both")
summary(x)
acf(residuals(model_glm))
pacf(residuals(model_glm))

exp(x$coefficients)

```

```{r}
performance::check_overdispersion(model_glm)
```

```{r}
resi_model <- residuals(model_glm)
acf(resi_model)
pacf(resi_model)
```

## GRAVES


```{r}
library(MASS)
base_graves <- base%>%mutate(graves=base_1$graves)%>%dplyr::select(-c(Nb_accidents,Mois,PL_seul,R2_seul, VL_seul,VL_VL))
glm_graves <- glm.nb(graves~., data = base_graves)
```

```{r}
glm_graves_2 <- step(glm_graves, trace = F)
summary(glm_graves_2)
```

```{r}
acf(residuals(glm_graves_2))
```

```{r}
pacf(residuals(glm_graves_2))
```


```{r message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}

base <- base_1%>%dplyr::select(-c(accidentologie,legers, graves,Deces))

y <- base_1$graves

variables <- names(base)



make_X <- function(vars, data) {
  if (length(vars) == 0) {
    return(matrix(1, nrow = nrow(data), ncol = 1))
  } else {
    return(model.matrix(as.formula(paste("~", paste(vars, collapse = "+"))), data = data))
  }
}

# Modèle initial avec toutes les variables
current_vars <- variables
X <- make_X(current_vars, base)

mod <- glarma(y = y, X = X, type = "NegBin", thetaLags = c(4,5,9),phiLags = NULL)
best_aic <- mod$aic
cat("AIC initial :", best_aic, "\n")


## Boucle backward stepwise

improve <- TRUE

while (improve && length(current_vars) > 0) {
  aics <- c()
  models <- list()
  
  for (var in current_vars) {
    temp_vars <- setdiff(current_vars, var)
    X_temp <- make_X(temp_vars, base)
    
    fit <- tryCatch({
      glarma(y = y, X = X_temp, type = "NegBin", thetaLags = c(4,5,9))
    }, error = function(e) NULL)
    
    if (!is.null(fit)) {
      aics <- c(aics, fit$aic)
      models[[var]] <- fit
    } else {
      aics <- c(aics, Inf)
    }
  }
  
  min_aic <- min(aics)
  best_idx <- which.min(aics)
  
  if (min_aic < best_aic) {
    best_aic <- min_aic
    var_to_remove <- current_vars[best_idx]
    current_vars <- setdiff(current_vars, var_to_remove)
    cat("Removed:", var_to_remove, "| New AIC:", best_aic, "\n")
  } else {
    improve <- FALSE
  }
}

cat("\n✅ Variables finales :", paste(current_vars, collapse = ", "), "\n")


```

```{r}
glarma_graves_2 <- glarma(y=y,X=make_X(current_vars, base), type="NegBin", thetaLags = c(4,5,9), phiLags = NULL)
summary(glarma_graves_2)
```

# Modèle final

h <- c("Vh_11_20", "Nuit_ep_eteint", "Nuit_ep_allume", "Lat_bon", "Nb_vehicules","Vh_bon_etat", "VL_Pieton","VU")

      aics <- c(aics, Inf)
    }
  }
  
  min_aic <- min(aics)
  best_idx <- which.min(aics)
  
  if (min_aic < best_aic) {
    best_aic <- min_aic
    var_to_remove <- current_vars[best_idx]
    current_vars <- setdiff(current_vars, var_to_remove)
    cat("Removed:", var_to_remove, "| New AIC:", best_aic, "\n")

}
